name: timothy-cli
description: CLI tool to upload LLM-generated HTML and share via time-limited URLs

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/tim.mjs --minify --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/tim.mjs
